summary: Conversation Habits now has four focused views with larger charts, expandable examples and clearer coverage, with aggregate insights available to AI review. This update also reduces canvas startup work and defaults new reviewer setups to Sonnet 5.5 with high reasoning.

AI reviews can now use verified Copilot model details and bundled coding benchmark evidence when available, with clear coverage and comparison limits. The preview and copied prompt include the same reference information sent for analysis.

Conversation Habits now shows recorded steering and queued prompts even when they share a run with another prompt. AI reviews use the corrected delivery counts and coverage, while token totals, credit accounting and conversation-depth calculations stay unchanged.

Skills now includes saved activations and failed loads even when a session has no billing receipts. Provider-unverified activity and excluded counts are clearly labelled, so older skill history is easier to understand without inventing charges.

Efficiency now compares recorded effort levels within each model and shows real model and effort changes, separating manual selections from automatic changes. Missing effort stays unknown, and no-op changes are ignored.
Skills now shows its selected date range and explains gaps in recorded skill activity. Show logs includes skill counts before and after filtering to help diagnose missing history on other computers.
Activity and When you work now keep your normal cursor while preserving the clickable title underline. Both enlarged charts use a Close button that matches the dashboard.

Click Activity or When you work to explore a larger chart with day and time-slot details. The Skills table now gives skill and project names more room and removes the source-plugin and plugin-version columns.

Recent usage now appears while older history loads in the background, without restoring old dashboard data. Wider ranges show a loading message, and Show logs includes separate timings for recent results and complete history.

Large VS Code histories load faster, and WSL database reads spend less time waiting. Show logs now lets you download the displayed diagnostics as a Markdown file, including cached logs when the server is unavailable.

Show logs now includes a load-time summary with timings for source discovery, file reading, databases, report preparation and display. It also shows how much data was read or reused, making slow startup easier to diagnose without sharing private content.

Worth a closer look now uses the same compact draggable selector as the token explorer, with an icon for each section. Drag, click or use the keyboard to explore patterns while keeping your selection through refreshes.

Conversation habits now shows steering, queued prompts and recorded user stops, with unknown data clearly marked. AI reviews can use these patterns while distinguishing collaboration from possible corrections.
The Refresh button takes up less space, with a closer icon and label and tighter padding.
The dashboard can reconnect after Copilot reloads its plugin extensions. Refresh now waits through brief connection interruptions, and logs make server restarts easier to identify.

AI review has less explanatory clutter, with routine metadata tucked into Review details. Targeted prompt excerpts are now an enabled-by-default setting; your choice is saved, and you can turn them off for statistics-only reviews.

Compact refresh controls now show a rotating arrow while usage updates and briefly confirm successful refreshes. The feedback stays inside the button, supports reduced motion, and works from both the toolbar and footer.

Conversation habits now charts how many prompts you use per session and the agent work between prompts, with clear coverage limits. AI reviews can use these patterns to explore how you work without treating short or long chats as inherently better.
AI reviews now show a miniature desktop exploring records, charts and comparisons while they run. Four animation variations create a longer cycle, with pause controls and reduced-motion support.

Create an AI review in one panel for the selected dates across all environments. Reviews now show emoji assessments, confidence dials and proportion graphics, with clearer progress, cancellation, a settings gear and a dismissible development notice.

Recognized cancellations, interrupted sessions and background plugin calls no longer trigger an orange warning; their details remain in Review coverage. Fixed prompt averages after resuming a session while preserving all recorded spending.

AI review now creates expandable insight cards with evidence and confidence. Choose model reasoning and optionally allow one bounded prompt review for more specific findings; each analysis shows its recorded usage.
Empty sessions with a recorded zero-credit total no longer trigger summary-only coverage warnings. Sessions with activity or uncertain usage remain visible for review.
The token explorer keeps the page steady when switching between tall and short sections, including when a coverage notice is visible. The slider stays in place while you explore.

Model breakdowns now expand into projects, then sessions, while keeping columns aligned. User prompts replaces the model-call count, so you can see your own submissions separately from the agent's follow-up work.

Coverage warnings now follow the current filters. Review coverage shows older and undated issues with file locations, and sessions recovered from the usage database no longer appear as summary-only exclusions.

Show logs now retains saved server diagnostics even if the first usage load loses its connection. You can also load saved runtime logs directly in the panel and copy everything without using a terminal.
Recovers older usage from locked WSL databases using a read-only reader inside the running distribution, with a setting to turn it off. Skill copy buttons now stay at the right edge of their column.
Expand a skill to see its uses, failures, and sessions by project. Project rows stay aligned beneath the skill totals, and the copy button still lets you find its folder.
Skill-folder links respond faster when you open a recorded skill location. New folder-opening timings help diagnose any remaining delays.

Restores VS Code calls that share a response ID and includes recorded conversation-compaction charges, correcting understated historical totals. Source-discovery diagnostics now survive reopening to help investigate missing WSL history.

Include recorded VS Code Copilot Chat usage from Windows and accessible WSL storage. The new All environments menu lets you focus the dashboard on one environment; source settings and coverage notes explain any missing history.

Windows now automatically includes Copilot CLI histories from running WSL distributions. Settings can disable discovery, and Local data sources explains stopped or unreadable environments so missing usage is easier to diagnose.

Minimum-height daily bars use the color of their largest token category. Incomplete-data asterisks follow the coverage notice: closing it hides the markers while keeping recorded values and coverage details available.

Small amounts of daily usage remain visible and clickable beside much busier days in token and AI credit charts. Tooltips keep the recorded amounts and explain when a bar uses a minimum visible height.

Usage loads immediately and refreshes every 15 minutes while visible, reducing background work. Returning to the dashboard refreshes only when its last successful scan is at least 15 minutes old; the Refresh button still updates on demand.

If a refresh loses its connection, the dashboard keeps the last loaded data with a clear notice. Improved connection diagnostics and small local lifecycle logs help investigate failures, including after reopening the dashboard.

Rolling 30 is now the default date filter, showing usage from the first of the current month through today. Last 30 days remains available separately, and both options share the same header building and light patterns.
Close the orange data coverage notice with its new X button. The same notice stays dismissed as you browse and refresh; changed warnings and newly opened dashboards still show it.

Usage now appears while Copilot's plugin and MCP inventories load in the background. Faster number formatting and less work in hidden token sections improve responsiveness; filters reuse the latest inventory.

Explore all ten token-efficiency sections with measured breakdowns and practical experiments. See work per prompt, delegated calls, cache reuse, reasoning, tool and skill footprints, and spend concentration, with clear coverage and limits.
All AI Review usage now appears under one project named Usage Insights, with a separate session for each review. Earlier reviews join the same project without changing their saved accounting.

AI Review now refreshes recorded usage as soon as a run finishes, including cancelled or failed runs. New reviews also handle long Copilot call identifiers correctly so live and saved copies of the same charge count only once.

Ask a selected GitHub Copilot model to review your usage directly in AI Review. Choose a model and verify your connection in Settings, preview what will be sent, and cancel a review at any time. Review usage appears in its own project.
The Projects table now shows a dash when a user-prompt count is unavailable, including for Enhanced Prompt background usage. Recorded model turns, tokens, and AI credits are unchanged.

Automatically includes retained Enhance Prompt background usage under the Enhanced Prompt project, with separate sessions for each helper. Recorded tokens and AI credits stay available after helpers finish; prompts and responses are not retained.

Made the token explorer shorter and flexible enough to fit narrow panels without a horizontal scrollbar. Small topic icons replace the labels, the blue lens changes its symbol as you move, and the selected section's full title stays visible.

Replaced the token-section dropdown with a draggable blue inspection lens and labelled stops. Explore all ten sections by dragging, clicking, using the keyboard, or choosing Previous and Next; your selection stays in place when data refreshes.
Moved Filter usage beneath the Efficiency section buttons. Your filter selections and expanded state stay intact when switching tabs, and Usage and Breakdown keep their original layout.

Added Sort by controls to Models and Projects so you can rank usage by tokens, credits, model turns, or name, plus user prompts for projects. Removed the daily bars' hover outline while keeping their gentle enlargement.

Made chart selections quieter: other days gently fade, model selections lose their background highlight, and project names underline on hover. Moved the prompt-cost coverage asterisk into a note below Projects.
Linked the footer product name to GitHub. Daily charts now fit without scrolling or labels above the bars; hovering gently enlarges only the stacked column, with detailed values in its tooltip.
Added daily totals above the chart bars and removed the maximum scale label. Crowded date ranges scroll horizontally so totals remain readable at every text size and number format.
Expanded release notes into a larger panel with clickable release families and versions, making it easier to browse updates while keeping the selected notes in view.
Made the footer version clickable and added an offline release-history panel with short notes for each Copilot release.
Added explicit credit to the original project and preserved the full MIT notice in the standalone dashboard.
Separated consumption views from workflow findings, with independent section pickers in both Efficiency dashboards.
Removed the extra introductory text from the Efficiency header.
Added a section picker with all proposed token-efficiency topics, showing one section at a time.
Restored column headings within expanded breakdown sections without changing alignment.
Aligned the columns across expanded usage breakdowns while retaining alternating background colors.
Added model and project selection on the Usage tab, user-prompt counts, and an unselected measurement default.
Kept chart tooltips readable near screen edges by moving them to the other side of the pointer.
Ordered token types as input, cache read, cache write, and output, with alternating percentage labels.
Added model breakdowns within project sessions and spaced the slashes in credit-rate card titles.
Added model-to-session-to-request expansion with matching metric columns and original prompts available on demand.
Added sorting by recorded failures in the Skills breakdown.
Changed AI credits per prompt to include complete linked agent work, with coverage for excluded or incomplete prompts.
Added a blue accent for dark mode and allowed clicking the selected measurement again to clear emphasis.
Used an accent color for the selected measurement and readable gray for other metrics.
Replaced shaded metric highlighting with bold values.
Replaced streak and model-count cards with credit-rate cards and clarified the token card labels.
Moved Refresh and Settings to the right side of the toolbar.
Added recorded skill-load failure counts, including skills with failed loads and no successful uses.
Emphasized the selected measurement, reordered usage columns, and made the token card follow the selected date range.
Split Efficiency into Where did the tokens go?, Worth a closer look, and AI review.
Restored the Usage Insights tab title and applied simplified formatting to fractional AI credits.
Shortened the canvas tab title to reduce clipping in the host app.
Added a saved Simplify numbers setting across the dashboard, using K, M, B, and T.
Redesigned Efficiency around context usage and practical experiments, with explicit context inspection and a manual AI-review snapshot.
Introduced the Efficiency tab with measured usage patterns and model comparisons.
Added filtered Copilot AI credits to the dashboard header.
Added project rows that expand into their sessions.
Added a support footer with refresh, settings, feedback, and copyable diagnostic logs and timings.
Reused scanned usage data for faster filtering, reduced prompt loading, and changed automatic refresh to 60 seconds.
Made model links neutral until hover and removed misleading busy cursors from request paging.
Added expandable model-request details with original prompts loaded only when requested.
Added three rotating window-light patterns per building, without animation.
Assigned buildings to fixed date-range positions, with all buildings for All history and none for custom dates.
Added consistent activity-panel headers and independent sorting for skills, plugins, and MCP servers.
Adjusted the banner positioning to reduce jumps when changing date ranges.
Added Skills, Plugins, and MCP buttons so Breakdown displays one activity panel at a time.
Added MCP server activity and status, plus an inventory of installed plugins.
Updated session names from Copilot desktop metadata so manually renamed chats appear correctly.
Added column dividers to the usage breakdown and replaced missing source-plugin labels with a dash.
Made long names wrap more gracefully and shortened the Last used date format.
Tightened the skills table, aligned its columns, and added subtle column dividers.
Added saved Small, Medium, and Large text-size settings.
Added readable session names and enlarged the GitHub Copilot heading.
Counted another recorded skill-use format and simplified the skills table with By user and By agent columns.
Added user and agent skill-use counts, reasoning-token metrics, and recorded tool outcomes.
Added installed skill versions separately from source-plugin versions.
Removed routine status and explanatory text below the skills table.
Added a copy button beside each skill name for its folder path.
Improved opening skill folders in Windows File Explorer.
Made skill names open their recorded folders.
Added daily token selection and a breakdown of recorded skill uses.
Added a token overview with input, output, and cache breakdowns.
Added the Usage Insights icon to the plugin listing.
Introduced the GitHub Copilot desktop plugin, with a local usage dashboard and marketplace installation.
